description: This file defines the LeaveTypeAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, implementing a RESTful API for managing leave types. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting leave type entities, and leverages traits and base classes for common API functionality.

classes.name: LeaveTypeAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing leave types, supporting CRUD operations with validation rules, and using traits for service access.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave type by ID, returning its representation if found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all leave types based on filtering and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new leave type based on request parameters and saves it.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing leave type identified by ID with new parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more leave types based on provided IDs.
